name: civitas
description: Query your local Civitas work memory through a permissioned MCP bridge
long_description: Civitas builds a personal work timeline and provenance-aware knowledge graph on your computer. This MCP server lets an explicitly configured client query the local Civitas API with read-only tools by default. State-changing actions and raw screenshots require separate opt-in scopes.

civitas_mcp_credential.title: Civitas client credential
civitas_mcp_credential.description: In Civitas Settings → Connections, copy setup for this client and paste its CIVITAS_MCP_CREDENTIAL value here. Never paste the device-owner API key.

tools.name: search-content
tools.description: Search through recorded screen content, audio transcriptions, and UI elements with speaker filtering

tools.name: list-meetings
tools.description: List detected meetings with duration, app, and attendees

tools.name: activity-summary
tools.description: Lightweight compressed activity overview for a time range (apps, recent texts, audio summary)

tools.name: search-elements
tools.description: Search structured UI elements (accessibility tree nodes and OCR text blocks)

tools.name: frame-context
tools.description: Get accessibility text, parsed tree nodes, and extracted URLs for a specific frame

tools.name: query_decisions
tools.description: Query decisions about an entity with their reasons, options considered (chosen and rejected), honesty note, and provenance

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Get an entity's current state, attributes, and relationships in the knowledge graph

tools.name: find_procedure
tools.description: Find how a workflow is performed from locally captured evidence

tools.name: who_knows
tools.description: Find who knows about a topic, ranked by attributable claim confidence (permission-gated)

tools.name: find_blockers
tools.description: Find what is blocking an entity and who said so, with provenance

tools.name: find_precedent
tools.description: Find the closest past precedent for a situation — what fixed a similar problem last time

tools.name: list_recent_decisions
tools.description: List the most recent decisions across all entities — the 'catch me up' feed, each with reasons, options, honesty, and provenance

tools.name: find_decision_options
tools.description: Show the alternatives considered for a decision and why each was chosen or rejected (rejected branches are first-class), with a criterion rollup

tools.name: trace_provenance
tools.description: Show the evidence behind a claim or decision: source episode, true event date, confidence, attribution, honesty contract, and conflicting claims

tools.name: find_contradictions
tools.description: Check whether a claim or entity is contested — returns conflicting claim pairs with an honest status (present / none / not_computed)

tools.name: get_context_pack
tools.description: Assemble everything needed to act on a task, permissioned: state, decisions, blockers, procedures, and connected people, each with provenance
